item.title: Conspiracy Notes Found Inside Sealed Products
item.description: Reports from Pennsylvania describe strange conspiracy-themed notes allegedly appearing inside sealed cereal, chocolate, cosmetics, and other retail products, raising questions about how they were inserted and by whom.
